page.title: Filtering best practices
page.description: Find the exact properties your clients demand, faster. Learn how to master our advanced Smart Search and filtering tools to instantly cut through the shared inventory and pinpoint the perfect match without reloading pages.
page.body:
Filtering is Key: Mastering Your Search


In a collaborative grid, finding what you need quickly is your strategic advantage. Our powerful filtering tools are engineered to help you cut through the clutter and locate the exact property your active buyer demands.
PropertyList updates results instantly as you adjust your parameters.
There is no need to constantly reload pages or click submit buttons - just add your desired criteria and watch the perfect properties dynamically appear.

Core Search Tools

Location or Reference Number Search: Begin your workflow by entering a specific location (such as a city, neighbourhood, or area code) or directly inputting a property reference number into the main search bar.
Smart Keyword Search: This intelligent tool enables you to search for highly precise criteria hidden within property descriptions, allowing you to find your ideal property quickly and efficiently.

Refine with Advanced Filters

Unleash the full power of our digital infrastructure by narrowing down your options based on specific metrics:
  • Price Range: Set minimum and maximum limits to find properties strictly within your client's budget.
  • Bedrooms: Specify the exact spatial requirements, including bedrooms and bathrooms.
  • Property Type: Narrow your search to specific asset classes like apartments, studios, villas, or commercial spaces.
  • Date Added: Select this option to exclusively view the latest mandates uploaded recently.
  • Property Status: Filter active properties versus Offline inventory (Sold or Off-market properties).
  • Property Features: Use our convenient checklist to select non-negotiable amenities, such as a Private Pool, Beach Front location, or Close to Schools.
  • Size: Define the required square metres (m2) for the interior build, terraces, and total plot.
  • Car Spaces: Specify the desired number of parking spaces.

Combine and Conquer

The true beauty of the Smart MLS lies in strategically combining these filters! For example, you can search for "apartments" in "Marbella" with a price range of "€500,000 - €700,000", requiring "3+ bedrooms", a "Covered Terrace", and a "Beach Front" location. This refines your results significantly, saving you immense time and frustration while co-broking.

Strategic Pro Tips

  • Exploit the Smart Keyword Search: Take your search to the next level by using precise, niche terms. Search for specific finishes like 'terracotta tiles' and 'double glazing', specific designers/architects, or unique building materials to refine your results even further.
  • Target Amenities: Optimise your search with strategic keywords! Include specific local amenities or nearby landmarks to target results based on the listing agent's property description.
  • Experiment with Filters: Test different combinations to find the exact workflow that suits your agency's needs.
  • Save Your Searches: PropertyList allows you to save your frequently used searches for instant access later. (See our upcoming section to learn how to automate this process).
With these strategies, you will master the PropertyList search infrastructure in no time, ensuring you never miss a matching mandate.
